solution.text:
T3: Crossed wires
a. Helical field line
The wire's field is circular, with magnitude \(\mu_0I/(2\pi\rho)\). Adding a constant axial field makes each field line a helix centred on the wire. Its handedness follows the right-hand rule for the current and the sign of the applied axial field. It is smooth, not closed, and has constant pitch at fixed radius.

b. Conserved flux tube
Near wire \(X\), its azimuthal field dominates, so the combined field line is a tightly wound spiral of slowly varying radius \(\rho(x)\). Consider the surface formed by all field lines through the radius-\(r\) circle at \(x=3a\). This is a flux tube. Its sides are tangent to the field, so no flux leaves them. The cross-sections are nearly circular because \(\rho\ll\sqrt{a^2+x^2}\).

The axial field comes from wire \(Y\): \(B_\parallel=(\mu_0I/2\pi)a/(a^2+x^2)\). It is approximately uniform across each small tube section. Conserved flux gives
\[B_\parallel\pi\rho^2=\frac{\mu_0Ia\rho^2}{2(a^2+x^2)}=\mathrm{const},\qquad\frac{\rho(x)^2}{a^2+x^2}=\frac{r^2}{10a^2}.\]
\[\rho(x)=\frac r{\sqrt{10}}\sqrt{1+\frac{x^2}{a^2}},\qquad d=\rho(0)=\frac r{\sqrt{10}}.\]
The validity ratio \(\rho/\sqrt{a^2+x^2}=r/(\sqrt{10}a)\) is constant and small along the whole tube.
c. Field-line length

To leading order the field-line tangent satisfies \(dx/dL\simeq B_\parallel/B_\perp\), with \(B_\perp\simeq\mu_0I/(2\pi\rho)\). The precise angular position of closest approach is negligible compared with the long tightly wound path. Hence
\[L\simeq\int_0^{3a}\frac{a^2+x^2}{a\rho(x)}\,dx=\frac{\sqrt{10}a^2}{r}\int_0^3\sqrt{1+u^2}\,du.\]
A single trapezoid gives the integral \(3(1+\sqrt{10})/2\simeq6.24\), yielding \(L\simeq197\,\mathrm m\), within the requested accuracy. Exact integration, for example using \(u=\sinh\beta\), gives
\[\int_0^3\sqrt{1+u^2}\,du=\frac12\left[3\sqrt{10}+\ln(3+\sqrt{10})\right]\simeq5.65,\]
\[L\simeq17.9\frac{a^2}{r}\simeq179\,\mathrm m.\]
The numeric field allows the requested 20 percent estimate, including the trapezoid result. The helix sketch remains self-review. Full source marking tables remain in the PDF.
